raw_segments.text: Do you know, Sonya, he said suddenly with conviction, let me tell you, if I'd simply
killed because I was hungry, laying stress on every word and looking enigmatically but
What would it matter to you?
He cried a moment later with a sort of despair.
What would it matter to you if I were to confess that I did wrong?
What do you gain by such a stupid triumph over me?
Ah, Sonya, was it for that I've come to you today?
